svg.title: trackfetch demo
svg.desc: Terminal recording: trackfetch reads songs.txt, skips two songs that were already downloaded, finds Daft Punk - One More Time on Spotify, scores five YouTube results, picks the best one, downloads it with yt-dlp and saves a tagged MP3.
